projects.title: African Swine Fever Risk
projects.short_summary: Model-based analyses for African Swine Fever risk assessment.
projects.abstract: This GeoEpi project brings together work on model-based analyses for African Swine Fever risk assessment. The project currently includes registered analytical work under the ASF-GBRTs subproject.

subprojects.title: Sensitivity to Epidemiological Traits of ASF Strains
subprojects.summary: Spatial transmission dynamics of African Swine Fever in wild pigs: Sensitivity to epidemiological traits of different viral strains.

projects.title: African Swine Fever Transmission by Feral Swine
projects.short_summary: Movement and genomic studies of ASF in feral swine.
projects.abstract: This GeoEpi project brings together movement and genomic studies of African Swine Fever in feral swine. Registered project work includes studies of swine movement and social cohesion and simulation of feral swine pedigrees based on admixture analysis.

subprojects.title: Swine Movement and Social Cohesion
subprojects.summary: Analysis and modeling of feral swine behavior, particularly the roles of relatedness and sex in pairwise cohesion and dyad formation.

subprojects.title: Simulation of feral swine pedigrees based on admixture analysis
subprojects.summary: Simulations in support of work led by Tim Smyser, APHIS NWRC.

projects.title: Patho-epidemiological Analyses of Foot-and-mouth Disease.
projects.short_summary: Studies incorporating FMD genomics, within-host dynamics, or animal experiment results.
projects.abstract: This GeoEpi project brings together studies incorporating foot-and-mouth disease genomics, within-host dynamics, or animal experiment results. Registered work includes an agent-based disease transmission model, sequence mapping, incubation-phase transmission, and FMDV co-infection and recombination.

subprojects.title: challengeABM an Agent-Based Disease Transmission Model
subprojects.summary: Agent Based Model (ABM) simulating within-host virus dynamics, room-to-room animal experiments, within-herd host transmission, and between-farm spread.

subprojects.title: Incubation Phase Transmission of Foot-and-mouth Disease
subprojects.summary: Incubation phase transmission of foot-and-mouth disease virus in cattle: experimental evidence and simulated impacts.

subprojects.title: FMDV Co-Infection and Recombination
subprojects.summary: Foot-and-mouth disease virus variability and recombination on dairy farms in Pakistan.

subprojects.title: Mapping Virus Diversity and Variation
subprojects.summary: Sequence-map converts aligned viral sequences and sampling geographic coordinates into PCA, DAPC, and other location-level summaries and optional spatial predictions of ordination-axis scores across geographic space.

projects.title: Foot-and-mouth Disease Risk Assessments
projects.short_summary: Foot-and-mouth spread dynamics, transmission, and simulated response analyses.
projects.abstract: This GeoEpi project brings together work on foot-and-mouth disease spread dynamics, transmission, and simulated response analyses. Registered work includes preclinical spread, control-zone design in Sri Lanka, and endemic foot-and-mouth disease analyses for Vietnam.

subprojects.title: Epidemiologic consequences of preclinical transmission of foot-and-mouth disease virus in cattle
subprojects.summary: Interspread Plus simulations calibrated to PIADC experimental studies by Jonathan Arzt.

subprojects.title: Designing Control Zones for Foot-and-mouth Disease in Sri Lanka
subprojects.summary: Supporting analysis and dimension reduction for a FMD Survey in Sri Lanka using Factor Analysis for Mixed Data (FAMD).

subprojects.title: Endemic FMD analyses for Vietnam
subprojects.summary: Understanding foot-and-mouth disease case distribution, virus diversity, and outbreak risk across Vietnam.

projects.title: Atmospheric Dispersion of HPAI
projects.short_summary: Retrospective analysis of atmospheric HPAI transport between poultry facilities.
projects.abstract: This GeoEpi project brings together retrospective analysis of atmospheric HPAI transport between poultry facilities. Registered work includes an atmospheric dispersion project, HPAI visualization and analyses, and tools for the Biosecurity Compliance Audit Program.

subprojects.title: Extraction and visualization Tools for Biosecurity Compliance Audit Program
subprojects.summary: bcapture provides tools for extracting, organizing, validating, summarizing, and viewing data from Biosecurity Compliance Audit Program (bCAP) forms.

subprojects.title: Atmospheric Dispersion of HPAI
subprojects.summary: Retrospective analysis of atmospheric HPAI transport between poultry facilities.

subprojects.title: HPAI visualization and analyses
subprojects.summary: Geographic analyses and visualizations for HPAI Plume Modeling Project.

projects.title: NWS Risk and Operational Decision Assessment
projects.short_summary: Build automated tools to assess NWS risk and support APHIS operational decision making.
projects.abstract: This GeoEpi project brings together automated tools for NWS risk assessment and support of APHIS operational decision making. Registered work includes geostatistical modeling, cellular automata, data processing, dashboard pipelines, and a group NWS repository.

subprojects.title: Bayesian NWS Geostatistical Model
subprojects.summary: Joint spatiotemporal modeling of NWS occurrence and intensity.

subprojects.title: NWS Cellular Automata
subprojects.summary: Initial Cellular Automata spread model, driven by environmental suitability and connectivity (no pop dynamics).

subprojects.title: Pipeline for CDS Data Processing
subprojects.summary: Automated pipeline for retrieving and preprocessing clinate and environmental rasters from the Climate Data Store (CDS).

subprojects.title: Pipeline for NWS Dashboard
subprojects.summary: Pipeline for reformmating NWS modeling results for use in Tableau dashboard.

subprojects.title: Group NWS Repository
subprojects.summary: Original group repository, cloned to Atlas. Includes parameter summaries, data directory schema, and project sandbox.

projects.title: Vesicular Stomatitis Virus Risk Assessments
projects.short_summary: Models and analyses focussed on VSV risks to the United States.
projects.abstract: This GeoEpi project brings together models and analyses focused on vesicular stomatitis virus risks to the United States. Registered work includes an SEIR-SEI outbreak model, genome and geography analyses, and a California outbreak project.

subprojects.title: Modeling the 2014-2015 Vesicular Stomatitis Outbreak in the United States using an SEIR-SEI Approach
subprojects.summary: SEIR-SEI model for VSV transmission, calibrated to 2014-15 outbreaks cycle.

subprojects.title: Interrogating Genomes and Geography to Unravel Multiyear Vesicular Stomatitis Epizootics
subprojects.summary: Phylogeography, phylodynamics, and geostatistical analysis of 2014-15 outbreak cycle.

subprojects.title: California Outbreak 2023
subprojects.summary: Phylogeography and prevalence of VSNJ during 2023 outbreak in California.

projects.title: West Nile Virus Risk Assessments for Livestock
projects.short_summary: Models and analyses examining WNV risk to U.S. livestock.
projects.abstract: This GeoEpi project brings together models and analyses examining West Nile virus risk to U.S. livestock. Registered work includes a graph neural network project and a GeoAI flavivirus sandbox.

subprojects.title: WNV Graph Neural Network in the Southern United States
subprojects.summary: Geospatial predictions of equine West Nile Virus outbreaks: Leveraging recurrent graph neural networks in the Southern Climate Region of the United States.

subprojects.title: GeoAI Flavivirus Sandbox
subprojects.summary: Sandbox repo for sharing code associated with the GeoAI and spatiotemporal epidemiology to forecast flavivirus transmission project.
